subject: Request for subsidized Private VPC POC (security evidence needed)
messages:
From: Alice Park <alice.park@medfolio.com>
To: priya_natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.example.com>
Cc: security@medfolio.com
Date: Wed, 09 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: subsidized Private VPC POC for compliance review

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the walkthrough earlier. As we discussed with our security team, Medfolio needs to evaluate Redwood in a Private/VPC setup to meet our data residency and SOC 2 requirements. Given the effort to stand up an isolated POC environment and the required audit evidence, we're asking if Redwood can provide subsidized credits and extend the trial window to 60 days so we can complete an internal pen test and one round of security review.

Key asks from security:
- Temporary VPC tenancy with isolated GPU capacity (no shared networks)
- Audit log access for the pilot window
- Brief SOC 2 artifact summary or attestation for the serving runtime
- Commitment on data retention for POC logs (30 days on our side)

We can provide an SoW if needed. Would appreciate any guidance on what evidence you can share up front (SOC 2 summary, architecture diagram, ephemeral creds).

Attaching our internal checklist for the POC (see attachment stub).

Best,
Alice
Director of Product, Medfolio
From: priya_natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.example.com>
To: Alice Park <alice.park@medfolio.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.example.com>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.example.com>
Date: Wed, 09 Jul 2025 13:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: subsidized Private VPC POC for compliance review

Alice — thanks for the clear list. We're interested in supporting Medfolio's evaluation and want to make this as smooth as possible. Quick summary of what we can offer immediately: 

- A 60-day Private VPC POC window (subject to security review)
- Up to $15k in subsidized credits toward dedicated GPU hours for the POC
- Audit/log access for the pilot and an exported summary of our SOC 2 scope (high-level, redacted)

Next steps from our side: I'll loop in Ben (SE) to propose the isolation topology and minimal infra we need to provision. Aditya from Pricing will weigh in on credit approvals and any contract MSA addenda.

Can you confirm the timeline for your pen test and whether Medfolio needs an on-net staging VPC or if a peered staging VPC is acceptable?

Thanks — Priya
Priya Natarajan
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.example.com>
To: Alice Park <alice.park@medfolio.com>, priya_natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.example.com>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.example.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Jul 2025 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: subsidized Private VPC POC for compliance review

Alice + team — attaching an isolation architecture draft and a short checklist for the POC setup. High-level notes:

- We can provision an isolated VPC in us-west-2 with customer-controlled subnets and a customer-managed VPN peering. That avoids colocating other tenants' control planes on the same network.
- Audit logs: we'll provide request/response traces and tokenized access logs for the pilot. Logs can be exported to your S3 for analysis.
- SOC 2: attaching a one-page SOC2-Summary.pdf that lists our attestation scope and control owners (redacted where necessary).
- For pen testing: we recommend a short maintenance window for kernel-level tracing; otherwise the POC should be testable without elevated privileges.

I have sketched the resource consumption estimate for a 60-day POC (approx 420 GPU hours) — with the $15k subsidy Priya mentioned, you're covered for the baseline testing. If you need extra runtime for extended stress tests we'll coordinate a top-up.

Let me know the preferred start date and your security contact for the export policy and S3 bucket ops.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

--- Attachment stubs: isolation-architecture-diagram.png, SOC2-Summary.pdf, pvoc-setup-checklist.md ---
From: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.example.com>
To: priya_natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.example.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.example.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Jul 2025 17:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: subsidized Private VPC POC for compliance review

Thanks for the context. Approving conditional subsidy as follows: 

- Approved: $15,000 in POC credits, valid for a 60-day Private VPC pilot (start date must be within 30 days of approval).
- Conditions: Signed NDA + Addendum confirming data handling for POC; security artifact handoff (SOC2 summary) before provisioning; Medfolio to confirm S3 export bucket settings and retention (30 days) before we enable audit log forwarding.
- Escalation path: If pen test requires >24 hours of kernel tracing or root-level access we require an MSA amendment and an additional security review.

I've added DocuSign envelope (DocuSign:EnvelopeID-9F3B) to the related links for the NDA/addendum. Priya — please confirm the HubSpot deal update (DEAL-8342) and set onboarding kickoff for next week if Medfolio signs.

Aditya Rao
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
